 This is a paid press release. Contact the press release distributor directly with any inquiries. Enter Abe's Graduate Scholarship Sweepstakes for the Chance to Win a $5,000 Grand Prize
 PR Newswire Mon, November 9, 2026 at 7:30 AM MST 3 min read Sweepstakes Has Reopened for Entries through February 28, 2027 
 BOSTON, Nov. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Graduate students and their families now have the chance to win $5,000 through Abe's Graduate Scholarship Sweepstakes,‡ which has reopened for new entries through February 28, 2027. 
 Abe student loans The no-essay sweepstakes, which originally ran from May 1, 2026 through July 31, 2026, is open to legal residents of the U.S./District of Columbia, age 18-plus, who are enrolled in a graduate-level program at an eligible institution, or the parents of these students. Entrants do not need to have an Abe ®  student loan  or to apply for one in order to win, and there are no GPA requirements. Following the February 28 entry deadline, the name of one lucky winner will be drawn. 
 The winner of the earlier sweepstakes is a J.D. candidate at Baylor University School of Law, who notes, "This prize will help provide books, course materials, and other essential study resources needed for my legal education." 
 Abe's Graduate Scholarship Sweepstakes has reopened as many graduate-level students face new pressures due to lower federal student loan borrowing limits, as well as changing definitions of professional degree programs. 
 The scholarship sweepstakes supplements other education financing opportunities from Abe to help them, including student loans for master's, doctoral, law school, MBA, medical, dental and healthcare professional programs. Borrowers pay no application, processing or late fees for the loans, which are available for full-time, part-time, or less than half-time programs of study and cover up to 100% of graduate school expenses.1 For more information, see https://www.abestudentloans.com/student-loans/graduate . 
 To enter Abe's Graduate Scholarship Sweepstakes, please click this link . For the sweepstakes rules, click here . 
 About Abe 
 Abe® student loans bring a plain, honest, "built-for-real-life" approach to private student lending. Abe covers up to the full cost of an education,1 and offers a unique combination of repayment plans, loan terms and deferment/forbearance options. Abe was created by Monogram LLC, the leader in data-driven private student lending products and programs. The Monogram team has originated $23 billion in private student loans and assisted 1.5 million borrowers at thousands of schools. More information can be found at  abestudentloans.com , Facebook  or Instagram . 
 ‡ NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. Open to legal residents of the 50 U.S./D.C., age 18+ who are currently a student or parent of a student enrolled in a graduate program at an Eligible Institution. Void where prohibited. Ends 02/28/27.  Click   for Official Rules . 
 Story Continues 1. The minimum loan amount is $1,000, except for (a) student applicants who are permanent residents of Iowa in which case the minimum loan amount is $1,001, and (b) student applicants or cosigners who are permanent residents of Massachusetts in which case the minimum loan amount is $6,001. The maximum loan amount to cover in-school expenses for each academic year is determined by the school's cost of attendance, minus other financial aid, as certified by the school. The requested loan amount cannot cause an individual student applicant's aggregate education loan debt (which includes federal and private student loans) to exceed $300,000 per student applicant applying for an undergraduate loan, $350,000 per student applicant applying for a graduate, graduate certificate, Healthcare Professionals, Law or MBA loan, or $500,000 per student applicant applying for a Medical or Dental loan. The requested loan amount cannot cause the aggregate education loan debt of a cosigner, applying jointly for an Abe loan, to exceed $999,999.99.
